title: Three Sessions and One Short Desk
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：government　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 government 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the clerk ① served a government that no deputy in the chamber would have described, and he said the serving was the whole of the session. The ② government, meaning the ministry itself and not the crown, ran three sessions and stayed undescribed in the book; a government, he said, is the only thing in a chamber that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ government in that chamber had the same short desk beside it, and the ④ government at the far bench, meaning the one they kept for the children's visit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A government, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three sessions.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the government was the whole of the matter, meaning the rule and not the ministry. The ⑥ government, meaning the rule and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; government, he said, is either something you serve or the only word that means both a ministry and a rule. He said the rule is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ government had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short desk. The ⑧ government of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in November, was one chamber and three sessions of describing; government, he said, is either the one at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ government I remember is the one described in the report, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the chamber. A ⑩ government, my mother said in 1983, is the only one that improves by being described; every government, she said, is a rule that has agreed to look like a ministry. She said the rule was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 政府（指议事厅里每一届旁边的那一届）
B. n. 政府（指那个内阁本身，与王权相对）
C. 固定搭配：serve a government 服务一届政府
D. n. 政府（指留给孩子们参观的那一届）
E. n. 政府（抽象总称，指一处议事厅的执政之事）
F. n. 政府（指报告里写到、被记录过的那一届）
G. n. 治理；管理（指一件事里人人都受却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 治理（抽象总称，指人人都受却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: served a government that no deputy in the chamber would have described
The government, meaning the ministry itself and not the crown
the government at the far bench
the government was the whole of the matter
the government had become a line in a report
The government of the whole thing
A government, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: serve a government 意为“服务一届政府”，1974 年那位书记员服务了议事厅里没有一位议员肯描述的一届政府。
government 意为“政府”，指那个内阁本身而不是王权，它经过了三个会期而在簿子上没有被描述。
government 意为“政府”，指议事厅里每一届旁边的那一届，每一届旁边都有同一张矮矮的办公桌。
government 意为“政府”，指最远那排长椅上留给孩子们参观的那一届，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
government 意为“治理、管理”，指一件事里人人都受却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种治理就是那件事的全部。
government 意为“治理”，指人人都受却无人提起的那样东西而不是那届政府，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
government 意为“政府”，指报告里写到、被记录过的那一届，到 1979 年这一届成了报告里的一行。
government 意为“政府”，书记员十一月写道，整件事的执政之事是一处议事厅和三个会期的描述。
government 意为“政府”，我记得的是报告里描述过的那一届，1981 年换届了，至今仍被说成议事厅里最安静的一届。
government 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，一届政府是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
